facts.text: The Navy covers 100% of tuition, room, board, and medical care for all midshipmen in exchange for a five-year active-duty service commitment after commissioning.

sources.title: General Information :: Admissions :: USNA
sources.quote: The Navy pays 100% of the tuition, room, and board, medical and dental care costs of Naval Academy midshipmen. This means ALL students who attend the Naval Academy do so on a full scholarship

facts.text: All midshipmen receive monthly pay of $1,273.20, with $100 per month paid in cash during plebe summer and $200 per month during the remainder of the first year after service deductions.

sources.title: General Information :: Admissions :: USNA
sources.quote: Midshipmen pay is $1,273.20 monthly, from which laundry, barber, cobbler, activities fees, yearbook and other service charges are deducted. Actual cash pay is $100 per month during plebe summer and $200 per month for the rest of your first year
